instruction: A sweeping desert canyon: layered red and orange sandstone walls with striations, a jade-green river curving around a gooseneck bend, a natural rock arch, saguaro cacti and scrub on the banks, a small raft floating downstream, hawks circling on thermals, and warm afternoon light raking across the strata.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Canyon River Bend. A sweeping desert canyon: layered red and orange sandstone walls with striations, a jade-green river curving around a gooseneck bend, a natural rock arch, saguaro cacti and scrub on the banks, a small raft floating downstream, hawks circling on thermals, and warm afternoon light raking across the strata. Style: southwest painterly. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
